original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')       and i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count,
    count(*) AS cnt
FROM
    (SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_quantity FROM store_sales) AS store_sales,
    (SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_warehouse_sk FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100) AS web_sales,
    (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d1,
    (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d2,
    (SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_hdemo_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM customer) AS customer,
    (SELECT inv_warehouse_sk, inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk, inv_quantity_on_hand FROM inventory) AS inventory,
    (SELECT s_state FROM store) AS store,
    (SELECT w_warehouse_sk, w_state FROM warehouse) AS warehouse,
    (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports') AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)) AS item,
    (SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status FROM customer_demographics) AS customer_demographics,
    (SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_vehicle_count FROM household_demographics) AS household_demographics,
    (SELECT ca_address_sk FROM customer_address WHERE ca_state IN ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')) AS customer_address
WHERE
    ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    AND ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    AND ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
    AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    AND ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    AND ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk
    AND ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
    AND inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
    AND inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity
    AND s_state = w_state
    AND c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
    AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
    AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
GROUP BY
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY
    cnt;

rewritten_query:
with customer_total_return as (
    select 
        sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk,
        sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk,
        sr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk,
        sum(SR_REFUNDED_CASH) as ctr_total_return 
    from store_returns, date_dim 
    where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk 
        and d_year = 2001 
        and sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 236 and 295 
    group by sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk
)
select c_customer_id
from customer_total_return ctr1
join (
    select 
        ctr_store_sk, 
        avg(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 as avg_ctr_total
    from customer_total_return
    group by ctr_store_sk
) as ctr_agg on ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr_agg.ctr_store_sk, store, customer, customer_demographics
where 
    ctr1.ctr_total_return > ctr_agg.avg_ctr_total
    and ctr1.ctr_reason_sk between 28 and 31
    and s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
    and s_state in ('MI', 'NC', 'WI')
    and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
    and cd_marital_status in ('W', 'W')
    and cd_education_status in ('4 yr Degree', 'College')
    and cd_gender = 'M'
    and c_birth_month = 5
    and c_birth_year between 1950 and 1956
order by c_customer_id
limit 100;

original_query: with customer_total_return as (select sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk ,sr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk ,sum(SR_STORE_CREDIT) as ctr_total_return from store_returns ,date_dim where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year =2000 and sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 107 and 166 group by sr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk)  select  c_customer_id from customer_total_return ctr1 ,store ,customer ,customer_demographics where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (select avg(ctr_total_return)*1.2 from customer_total_return ctr2 where ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk ) and ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 17 AND 20 and s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk and s_state IN ('MO', 'NC', 'PA') and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'W') and cd_education_status IN ('College', 'Unknown') and cd_gender = 'F' and c_birth_month = 5 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1962 order by c_customer_id limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
        sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
        SUM(SR_STORE_CREDIT) AS ctr_total_return 
    FROM store_returns 
    JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 2000 
        AND (sr_return_amt / NULLIF(sr_return_quantity,0)) BETWEEN 107 AND 166 
    GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk
),
avg_return AS (
    SELECT 
        ctr_store_sk, 
        AVG(ctr_total_return)*1.2 AS avg_val 
    FROM customer_total_return 
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT 
    c.c_customer_id 
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN avg_return ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = avg_return.ctr_store_sk AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > avg_return.avg_val
JOIN (SELECT s_store_sk FROM store WHERE s_state IN ('MO','NC','PA')) s ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN (SELECT c_customer_id, c_customer_sk, c_current_cdemo_sk FROM customer WHERE c_birth_month=5 AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1962) c ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk

WHERE 
    ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 17 AND 20 
ORDER BY c_customer_id 
LIMIT 100;

WITH cross_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk
  FROM item
  JOIN (
    SELECT iss.i_brand_id AS brand_id, iss.i_class_id AS class_id, iss.i_category_id AS category_id
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN item iss ON ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    WHERE d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND iss.i_category IN ('Books','Home','Jewelry')
      AND iss.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN item ics ON cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ics.i_category IN ('Books','Home','Jewelry')
      AND ics.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    INTERSECT
    SELECT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN item iws ON ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    WHERE d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND iws.i_category IN ('Books','Home','Jewelry')
      AND iws.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) x ON i_brand_id = x.brand_id AND i_class_id = x.class_id AND i_category_id = x.category_id
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books','Home','Jewelry')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100

SELECT
  this_year.channel AS ty_channel,
  this_year.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
  this_year.i_class_id AS ty_class,
  this_year.i_category_id AS ty_category,
  this_year.sales AS ty_sales,
  this_year.number_sales AS ty_number_sales,
  last_year.channel AS ly_channel,
  last_year.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
  last_year.i_class_id AS ly_class,
  last_year.i_category_id AS ly_category,
  last_year.sales AS ly_sales,
  last_year.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM (
  SELECT
    'store' AS channel,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales,
    COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN cross_items ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = cross_items.ss_item_sk
  JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  WHERE date_dim.d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5)
    AND item.i_category IN ('Books','Home','Jewelry')
    AND item.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
    AND store_sales.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
) this_year
JOIN (
  SELECT
    'store' AS channel,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales,
    COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN cross_items ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = cross_items.ss_item_sk
  JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  WHERE date_dim.d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5)
    AND item.i_category IN ('Books','Home','Jewelry')
    AND item.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
    AND store_sales.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
) last_year
  ON this_year.i_brand_id = last_year.i_brand_id
  AND this_year.i_class_id = last_year.i_class_id
  AND this_year.i_category_id = last_year.i_category_id
ORDER BY this_year.i_brand_id, this_year.i_class_id, this_year.i_category_id

    cs_quantity,
    cs_list_price,
    cs_coupon_amt,
    cs_sales_price,
    cs_net_profit,

rewritten_query:
SELECT 
    item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, 
    item.i_brand AS brand, 
    item.i_manufact_id, 
    item.i_manufact, 
    SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price
FROM 
    (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year=2002 AND d_moy=8) AS date_dim
JOIN 
    (SELECT ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_ext_sales_price 
     FROM store_sales 
     WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100) AS store_sales 
    ON date_dim.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN 
    (SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand, i_manufact_id, i_manufact 
     FROM item 
     WHERE i_category='Home') AS item 
    ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
JOIN 
    (SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk 
     FROM customer 
     WHERE c_birth_month=4) AS customer 
    ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
JOIN 
    (SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_zip 
     FROM customer_address 
     WHERE ca_state='GA') AS customer_address 
    ON customer.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk
JOIN 
    (SELECT s_store_sk, s_zip 
     FROM store) AS store 
    ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
WHERE 
    substring(customer_address.ca_zip,1,5) <> substring(store.s_zip,1,5)
GROUP BY 
    item.i_brand, 
    item.i_brand_id, 
    item.i_manufact_id, 
    item.i_manufact
ORDER BY

    item.i_brand,

WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    ca_state AS ctr_state,
    wr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
    SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM web_returns
  JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN customer_address ON wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  JOIN item ON wr_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE d_year = 2001
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 69 AND 78
    AND wr_return_amt / wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 28 AND 57
  GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state, wr_reason_sk
)
SELECT 
  c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag,
  c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address,
  c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    ctr_state, 
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_return
  FROM customer_total_return
  GROUP BY ctr_state
) state_avg ON ctr1.ctr_state = state_avg.ctr_state
JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
  AND ca_state IN ('IA', 'MT', 'NE', 'TX')
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg.avg_return
  AND ctr1.ctr_reason_sk IN (3, 31)
ORDER BY 
  c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag,
  c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address,
  c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

WITH ss AS (
    SELECT 
        ca_county,
        d_qoy, 
        d_year,
        SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    INNER JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
        AND ca_state IN ('GA','IL')
        AND ca_address_sk IS NOT NULL
    INNER JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
        AND i_color IN ('purple', 'sandy')
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 55
        AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    WHERE 
        ss_list_price BETWEEN 77 AND 91
        AND ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND ss_addr_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year
), 
ws AS (
    SELECT 
        ca_county,
        d_qoy, 
        d_year,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    INNER JOIN customer_address ON ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
        AND ca_state IN ('GA','IL')
        AND ca_address_sk IS NOT NULL
    INNER JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
        AND i_color IN ('purple', 'sandy')
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 55
        AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    WHERE 
        ws_list_price BETWEEN 77 AND 91
        AND ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND ws_bill_addr_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year
)
SELECT 
    ss1.ca_county,
    ss1.d_year,
    ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales AS web_q1_q2_increase,

    ss ss1,
    ss ss2,
    ss ss3,
    ws ws1,
    ws ws2,
    ws ws3

    ss1.d_qoy = 1
    AND ss1.d_year = 2001

    AND CASE WHEN ws2.web_sales > 0 THEN ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss2.store_sales > 0 THEN ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales ELSE NULL END
    AND ss1.ca_county IS NOT NULL

    w_state,

    SUM(cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash,0)) FILTER (WHERE d_date < DATE '1998-04-26') AS sales_before,

    (SELECT

    ON (cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk)
    INNER JOIN 
    (SELECT w_warehouse_sk, w_state FROM warehouse) AS w 
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN 
    (SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id FROM item 
     WHERE i_category = 'Home' AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 67) AS i 
    ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    INNER JOIN

filtered_store AS (

SELECT 
    min(s_store_name),
    min(s_company_id),
    min(s_street_number),
    min(s_street_name),
    min(s_suite_number),

    min(s_zip),
    min(ss_ticket_number),
    min(ss_sold_date_sk),

    min(d1.d_date_sk)
FROM 
    (SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_store_sk 
     FROM store_sales 
     WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_store_sk IS NOT NULL) AS store_sales

    (SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk 
     FROM store_returns 
     WHERE sr_customer_sk IS NOT NULL AND sr_store_sk IS NOT NULL AND sr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL) AS store_returns

with my_customers as (
  select distinct c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
  from (
    select 
      c_customer_sk, 
      c_current_addr_sk
    from catalog_sales
    join item on catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    join date_dim on catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    join customer on catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    where item.i_category = 'Men'
      and item.i_class = 'accessories'
      and date_dim.d_moy = 7
      and date_dim.d_year = 1999
      and catalog_sales.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74
      and customer.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1943 AND 1956
    union all
    select 
      c_customer_sk, 
      c_current_addr_sk
    from web_sales
    join item on web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    join date_dim on web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    join customer on web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    where item.i_category = 'Men'
      and item.i_class = 'accessories'
      and date_dim.d_moy = 7
      and date_dim.d_year = 1999
      and web_sales.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74
      and customer.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1943 AND 1956
  ) as cs_or_ws_sales
)
, my_revenue as (
  select 
    my_customers.c_customer_sk,
    sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as revenue
  from my_customers
  join store_sales 
    on my_customers.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk
    and store_sales.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74
  join customer_address 
    on my_customers.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk
    and customer_address.ca_state in ('GA','IL','IN','MT','NC','NM','OH','OR','TX','VA')
  join store 
    on customer_address.ca_county = store.s_county 
    and customer_address.ca_state = store.s_state
    and store.s_state in ('GA','IL','IN','MT','NC','NM','OH','OR','TX','VA')
  join date_dim 
    on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    and date_dim.d_month_seq between (select distinct d_month_seq+1 from date_dim where d_year = 1999 and d_moy = 7) 
                          and (select distinct d_month_seq+3 from date_dim where d_year = 1999 and d_moy = 7)
  group by my_customers.c_customer_sk
)
, segments as (
  select cast((revenue/50) as int) as segment 
  from my_revenue
)
select 
  segment, 
  count(*) as num_customers, 
  segment*50 as segment_base
from segments
group by segment
order by segment, num_customers
limit 100;

WITH base_month AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 6
),
my_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
    FROM (
        SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
               cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
               cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
               cs_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost
        FROM catalog_sales
        WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
               ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
               ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
               ws_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost
        FROM web_sales
        WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48
    ) cs_or_ws_sales,
    item,
    date_dim,
    customer
    WHERE sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        AND item_sk = i_item_sk
        AND i_category = 'Sports'
        AND i_class = 'camping'
        AND c_customer_sk = cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk
        AND d_moy = 6
        AND d_year = 2001
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1932 AND 1945
),
my_revenue AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk,
           SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM my_customers
    JOIN store_sales ON my_customers.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk
        AND store_sales.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48
    JOIN customer_address ON my_customers.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store ON customer_address.ca_county = store.s_county
        AND customer_address.ca_state = store.s_state
        AND store.s_state IN ('IA','MD','MO','MS','NE','NY','OK','TN','TX','VA')
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
        AND date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT d_month_seq+1 FROM base_month) 
                                 AND (SELECT d_month_seq+3 FROM base_month)
    GROUP BY c_customer_sk
),
segments AS (
    SELECT CAST((revenue/50) AS INT) AS segment
    FROM my_revenue
)
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS num_customers, segment*50 AS segment_base
FROM segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment, num_customers
LIMIT 100;

WITH month_seq AS (
    SELECT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = '1999-02-11'
),
target_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq = (SELECT d_month_seq FROM month_seq)
),
ss_items AS (
    SELECT 
        i_item_id AS item_id,
        c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    WHERE 
        d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM target_dates)
        AND ss_list_price BETWEEN 269 AND 298
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
    GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
),
cs_items AS (
    SELECT 
        i_item_id AS item_id,
        c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    WHERE 
        d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM target_dates)
        AND cs_list_price BETWEEN 269 AND 298
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
    GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
),
ws_items AS (
    SELECT 
        i_item_id AS item_id,
        c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    WHERE 
        d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM target_dates)
        AND ws_list_price BETWEEN 269 AND 298
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
    GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        ss.item_id,
        ss.birth_year,
        ss.ss_item_rev,
        cs.cs_item_rev,
        ws.ws_item_rev,
        (ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev) / 3.0 AS average
    FROM ss_items ss
    JOIN cs_items cs ON ss.item_id = cs.item_id AND ss.birth_year = cs.birth_year
    JOIN ws_items ws ON ss.item_id = ws.item_id AND ss.birth_year = ws.birth_year
    WHERE
        ss.ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs.cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs.cs_item_rev
        AND ss.ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws.ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws.ws_item_rev
        AND cs.cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws.ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws.ws_item_rev
)
SELECT
    item_id,
    birth_year,
    ss_item_rev,
    (ss_item_rev / average) * 100 AS ss_dev,
    cs_item_rev,
    (cs_item_rev / average) * 100 AS cs_dev,
    ws_item_rev,
    (ws_item_rev / average) * 100 AS ws_dev,
    average
FROM joined_data
ORDER BY item_id, birth_year, ss_item_rev
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq = (SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2001-04-16')
),
ss_items AS (
    SELECT 
        i_item_id AS item_id,

    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk

        AND customer.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953
    GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
),
cs_items AS (
    SELECT 
        i_item_id AS item_id,
        c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN item ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
        AND item.i_manager_id BETWEEN 71 AND 100

),
ws_items AS (

        i_item_id AS item_id,

        AND customer.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1947 AND 1953

)
SELECT 
    ss_items.item_id,
    ss_items.birth_year,
    ss_items.ss_item_rev,
    ss_items.ss_item_rev / ((ss_items.ss_item_rev + cs_items.cs_item_rev + ws_items.ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ss_dev,

              ,cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr_return_quantity,0) AS sales_cnt

        FROM (SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_order_number, cs_quantity, cs_ext_sales_price, cs_sales_price, cs_list_price, cs_sold_date_sk FROM catalog_sales) AS catalog_sales
        JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category='Women') AS item ON item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk
        JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_year FROM date_dim) AS date_dim ON date_dim.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT cr_order_number, cr_item_sk, cr_return_quantity, cr_return_amount, cr_reason_sk FROM catalog_returns) AS catalog_returns 
               ON (catalog_sales.cs_order_number = catalog_returns.cr_order_number AND catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = catalog_returns.cr_item_sk)
        WHERE catalog_sales.cs_sales_price / catalog_sales.cs_list_price BETWEEN 68 * 0.01 AND 88 * 0.01

              ,i_brand_id

        LEFT JOIN (SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_return_quantity, sr_return_amt, sr_reason_sk FROM store_returns) AS store_returns

        WHERE store_sales.ss_sales_price / store_sales.ss_list_price BETWEEN 68 * 0.01 AND 88 * 0.01
          AND store_returns.sr_reason_sk in (9, 19, 23, 33, 44)

WITH catalog_sales_detail AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         SUM(cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr_return_quantity,0)) AS sales_cnt,
         SUM(cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_return_amount,0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM (SELECT * FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.77 AND 0.97) cs
  JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_category='Sports') i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM catalog_returns WHERE cr_reason_sk IN (59,63,65,68,70)) cr 
    ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
),
store_sales_detail AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         SUM(ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr_return_quantity,0)) AS sales_cnt,
         SUM(ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr_return_amt,0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM (SELECT * FROM store_sales WHERE ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.77 AND 0.97) ss
  JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_category='Sports') i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM store_returns WHERE sr_reason_sk IN (59,63,65,68,70)) sr 
    ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
),
web_sales_detail AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         SUM(ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr_return_quantity,0)) AS sales_cnt,
         SUM(ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr_return_amt,0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM (SELECT * FROM web_sales WHERE ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.77 AND 0.97) ws
  JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_category='Sports') i ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM web_returns WHERE wr_reason_sk IN (59,63,65,68,70)) wr

WITH date_filter AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) AND CAST('1999-09-24' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
item_filter AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price > 50
      AND i_category IN ('Home', 'Men')
),
promotion_filter AS (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'N'
      AND p_channel_tv = 'N'
      AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
      AND p_channel_press = 'N'
      AND p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
ssr AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id AS store_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr 
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk 
        AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48
    JOIN date_filter d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item_filter i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion_filter p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id
),
csr AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr 
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk 
        AND cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
        AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48
    JOIN date_filter d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN item_filter i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion_filter p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
    SELECT
        web.web_site_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr 
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk 
        AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
        AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 33 AND 48
    JOIN date_filter d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site web ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = web.web_site_sk
    JOIN item_filter i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion_filter p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY web.web_site_id
)
SELECT
    channel,
    id,
    SUM(sales) AS sales,
    SUM(returns) AS returns,
    SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || store_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100;

WITH date_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
),
cd_filtered AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = '4 yr Degree')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
)
SELECT
    MIN(ws_quantity),
    MIN(wr_refunded_cash),
    MIN(wr_fee),
    MIN(ws_item_sk),
    MIN(wr_order_number),
    MIN(cd1.cd_demo_sk),
    MIN(cd2.cd_demo_sk)
FROM web_sales
JOIN web_returns ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = web_returns.wr_item_sk
    AND web_sales.ws_order_number = web_returns.wr_order_number
JOIN web_page ON web_sales.ws_web_page_sk = web_page.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN date_filtered ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_filtered.d_date_sk
JOIN cd_filtered cd1 ON web_returns.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN cd_filtered cd2 ON web_returns.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
    AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
JOIN customer_address ON web_returns.wr_refunded_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk
JOIN reason ON web_returns.wr_reason_sk = reason.r_reason_sk
WHERE (
    (
        cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U'
        AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
        AND web_sales.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
    )
    OR (
        cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D'
        AND cd1.cd_education_status = '4 yr Degree'
        AND web_sales.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
    )
    OR (
        cd1.cd_marital_status = 'M'
        AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College'
        AND web_sales.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
    )
)
AND (
    (
        customer_address.ca_country = 'United States'
        AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('NE', 'TN', 'TX')
        AND web_sales.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
    )
    OR (
        customer_address.ca_country = 'United States'
        AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('MS', 'NY', 'VA')
        AND web_sales.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
    )
    OR (
        customer_address.ca_country = 'United States'
        AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('MS', 'TN', 'TX')
        AND web_sales.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
    )
);

original_query: select  c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name, count(*) as cnt FROM store_sales, store_returns, web_sales, date_dim d1, date_dim d2, item, customer, customer_address, household_demographics WHERE ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND sr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Sports') AND sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date between d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '90' day) AND ca_state in ('IA', 'KS', 'MD', 'MO', 'OK') AND d1.d_year = 2000 AND hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20 AND hd_buy_potential = '0-500' AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 38 * 0.01 AND 58 * 0.01 GROUP BY c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name ORDER BY cnt ;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Sports')
),
filtered_customer_address AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('IA', 'KS', 'MD', 'MO', 'OK')
),
filtered_household_demographics AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20
      AND hd_buy_potential = '0-500'
),
filtered_d1 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, ss_item_sk
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 38 * 0.01 AND 58 * 0.01
      AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filtered_store_sales ss
JOIN (SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_returned_date_sk FROM store_returns) sr
    ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
JOIN (SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk FROM web_sales) ws
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
JOIN filtered_d1 d1
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim) d2
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '90' DAY)
JOIN (SELECT c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_current_addr_sk, c_current_hdemo_sk FROM customer) c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND c.c_current_addr_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND c.c_current_hdemo_sk IS NOT NULL
JOIN filtered_customer_address ca
    ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN filtered_household_demographics hd
    ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN filtered_item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
ORDER BY cnt;
